App development club (2025 - now, team lead of 4 since 2026)
Sufra - splits the cost of shared meals between friends (published on Google Play, 1,200 installs)
- Built in Flutter with Dart; state is handled with Provider.
- Every screen works in Arabic and English, with layouts that flip for right-to-left.
- Saves groups and expenses in Firebase Firestore and signs users in with a code sent to their phone number.
- Went through the Play Console steps myself: signing, store listing, screenshots and a closed test with 20 club members before the public release.
- Read the Crashlytics reports after launch and fixed the three most common crashes; crash-free sessions went from 96.1% to 99.4%.
- Turned the club designer's Figma screens into widgets and a small set of shared components.

Qa'ati - finds a free study room on campus (not published)
- Shows free rooms by reading the timetable from a JSON feed that the college IT unit exposes, and keeps the last result for when there is no signal.
- Reminds the user ten minutes before a booked slot ends with a notification scheduled on the device.
- Wrote widget tests for the booking form.
- The team works on feature branches and merges through pull requests; tasks are on a Trello board.
